messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: latency_slo_breach (service: streaming-api) p99=5.2s p95=1.1s. Trigger: prefix-cache hitrate < 10% on shard group 'convoy-0'. Auto-mitigation: started fallback routing to fallback-model-v2 for 20% traffic. See: https://internal.incidents/2378200000

alex (on-call): ack — I'm on it. tagging @maria and @jin. any immediate customer-visible errors?

maria (SRE): seeing streaming stalls on a subset of pods, clients hitting stalled chunk delivery. p95 jump around 1s, but p99 spikes 4-6s. Error rate for streaming chunks increased ~0.7% but retries hide some impact.

jin (eng-runtime): confirmed prefix_hash rollout completed 30m ago. metrics show prefixcache_local_hit_rate dropped from ~78% to ~7% across convoy-0. suspect hash->bucket remap caused mass cold misses.

alex (on-call): timeline? did rollout change namespace or salt?

jin (eng-runtime): rollout bumped prefix_hash v=12 -> v=13; new shard mapping changed bucket assignments mid-traffic. cache invalidation triggered ephemeral thrash. logs: `prefixsync: remap 128->256 buckets, invalidate=convoy-0`

maria (SRE): can we stop the rollout and roll back quickly? that should restore hot keys mapping.

jin (eng-runtime): I'm preparing a rollback. plan: set config flag `prefix_hash.active_version=12` and restart mapping daemon on control-plane only — this preserves runtime nodes until they pick new mapping. Command: ```rwctl config set prefix_hash.active_version=12 --env=prod && rwctl deploy control-plane/mapping-daemon --force-restart``` Doing canary apply to mapping-control-1 first.

alex (on-call): do that. also increase fallback routing to 60% to reduce customer impact while we rollback. ops-bot, can you bump?

ops-bot: done — traffic steering updated: fallback-model-v2 now receives 60% of streaming requests for convoy-0 for 30m.

sophia (product): which customers are hit? any enterprise panels?

maria (SRE): top 3 affected orgs by request volume: org-omega, beta-saas, quickchat. We have ~5 support tickets mentioning stalls, CS notified. No PII or failed generation—just latency/timeouts on streaming.

jin (eng-runtime): started rollback on mapping-control-1 (canary). Observing local metrics: prefixcache_local_hit_rate up to 24% on that node within 90s. If stable, will roll forward rollback to the rest.

maria (SRE): running a quick histogram check: ```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(streaming_response_duration_seconds_bucket[2m])) by (le))
``` shows p99 for convoy-0 from 5.2s -> 1.2s on canary node. Good signal.

alex (on-call): keep rollback staged. Also schedule a cache warm job to prefetch top prefixes to convoy-0 once mapping is stable. Jin, can you trigger prefetcher?

jin (eng-runtime): yes. after rollback completes I'll run: ```prefetcher --shard convoy-0 --top-prefixes 10000 --mode background``` Should prime KV and prefix caches.

maria (SRE): small note — eviction policy on convoy-0 is LFU with short TTL; mass prefetch might evict other useful entries. We'll scope to top-10k by RPS and run slow ramp.

alex (on-call): agree. ops-bot, set rate-limit for prefetcher to 2000 qps equivalent.

ops-bot: rate limit set.

sophia (product): want to prepare comms: short status for CS and affected customers. Suggest: "We detected a prefix-cache remap that temporarily increased request latency. We rolled back the mapping and are priming caches; most customers should see improvements within minutes."

maria (SRE): customer impact assessment: estimated affected traffic ~12% of total streaming traffic for 18m window, p99 peaked 5.2s, ~0.6% client retries, no data loss. Recommend SEV3.

alex (on-call): agree SEV3. I'll update incident board. Jin, status on rollback progress?

jin (eng-runtime): rolled back to v12 across mapping-control- nodes; rolling rest now. full rollout expected +8m. Prefetcher queued to start post-rollout.

maria (SRE): monitoring: global prefixcache_hit_rate trending up from 7% -> 46% as nodes come back. p95 back to ~220ms, p99 ~380ms on current sample.

alex (on-call): excellent. leave routing fallback at 60% for now until p99 < 500ms for 5m. then reduce to 20% then remove.

jin (eng-runtime): noted. starting staged reduction when p99 stable. Also creating postmortem ticket: link https://internal.pm/INC-2378200000

sophia (product): add a short blurb for CS: timeline, mitigation, next steps (postmortem/RCAs). I'll draft.

maria (SRE): follow-ups: 1) review prefix hash rollout safety checks (canary mapping vs. full invalidation), 2) add automated pre-rollout warmup for top-10k prefixes, 3) increase monitoring alert fidelity to include hitrate deltas >30% within 5m.

alex (on-call): assigning 1->jin, 2->maria, 3->maria. update incident board with tasks.

ops-bot: incident state: mitigated -> active rollback in progress -> auto-mitigation traffic steering 60% applied.

alex (on-call): thanks all. I'll keep the channel open until we mark mitigated. ping me if p99 climbs again. :thumbsup:

(END)
